name: 231. Client tool_result tool_reference reaches the provider on every inbound route (client-tool-reference) (#7813)
description: Custom (client-side) tool search: a client tool returns tool_reference blocks inside its tool_result, and Anthropic loads the referenced deferred tools (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/tool-search-tool#custom-tool-search-implementation). Upstream #7813: the Responses converters kept only text, image and document inside a client tool_result, so the reference was dropped, the request still returned 200 and the deferred tool never loaded. Each case replays the same conversation (find_tools called, its tool_result holding a text part and a tool_reference to the deferred get_weather) and pins the provider egress through x-bf-send-back-raw-request. Routes that reach Anthropic's converters: the Anthropic SDK surface on Anthropic, Vertex and Bedrock (Bedrock sends defer_loading requests through InvokeModel), and the neutral /v1/responses surface, where the reference arrives as a tool_reference block in function_call_output and the client cannot send anthropic-beta, so the gateway must derive the tool-search beta from defer_loading. The Anthropic-format request routed to OpenAI must lose the Anthropic-only block before function_call_output is flattened. Not covered: Azure (Foundry Claude) has no deployment in the harness profile; Bedrock Mantle is not a tool-search route here. Whether the model then calls get_weather cannot be forced, so the raw_request assertions are the pass condition.

item.name: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 /anthropic/v1/messages client tool_result tool_reference reaches the provider - client-tool-reference - #7813

exec: var txt = pm.response.text() || '';
var body = {};
try { body = pm.response.json() || {}; } catch (e) { body = {}; }
var rr = (body.extra_fields || {}).raw_request;
if (typeof rr === 'string') { try { rr = JSON.parse(rr); } catch (e) { rr = null; } }
var wire = JSON.stringify(rr || null);
pm.test('anthropic claude-sonnet-4-6 /anthropic/v1/messages tool_reference: request accepted (200)', function () {

pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'want 200; a 400 means the tool_reference reached Anthropic malformed or defer_loading was stripped, any other status is a real failure: ' + txt.slice(0, 400)).to.eql(200);
pm.test('anthropic claude-sonnet-4-6 /anthropic/v1/messages tool_reference: the tool_result reaches the provider with its tool_reference block', function () {
if (pm.response.headers.get('x-bifrost-request-type') === 'passthrough') {
// Native Messages passthrough forwards the caller's body as sent and returns Anthropic's own
// bytes, so there is no raw_request; the route tests cover those bytes offline.
pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('x-bifrost-provider'), 'native passthrough answered by another provider: ' + txt.slice(0, 300)).to.eql('anthropic');
return;
pm.expect(rr, 'raw_request missing or unparseable - x-bf-send-back-raw-request not honored: ' + txt.slice(0, 300)).to.be.an('object');
var msgs = Array.isArray(rr.messages) ? rr.messages : [];
var results = [];
msgs.forEach(function (m) { (Array.isArray(m && m.content) ? m.content : []).forEach(function (b) { if (b && b.type === 'tool_result') { results.push(b); } }); });
pm.expect(results.length, 'exactly one tool_result must reach the provider: ' + wire.slice(0, 900)).to.eql(1);
var inner = Array.isArray(results[0].content) ? results[0].content : [];
var refs = inner.filter(function (b) { return b && b.type === 'tool_reference'; });

pm.expect(refs.length, 'tool_reference dropped from the client tool_result before the provider (pre-#7813: the Responses converters kept only text, image and document): ' + JSON.stringify(results[0])).to.eql(1);
pm.expect(refs[0].tool_name, 'tool_reference.tool_name: ' + JSON.stringify(refs[0])).to.eql('get_weather');
var texts = inner.filter(function (b) { return b && b.type === 'text'; });
pm.expect(texts.length && texts[0].text, 'the text part of the tool_result must survive beside the reference: ' + JSON.stringify(results[0])).to.eql('Found 1 tool');
var tools = Array.isArray(rr.tools) ? rr.tools : [];
var deferred = tools.filter(function (t) { return t && t.name === 'get_weather'; });
pm.expect(deferred.length === 1 && deferred[0].defer_loading, 'the referenced tool must reach the provider with defer_loading kept: ' + wire.slice(0, 900)).to.eql(true);
pm.test('anthropic claude-sonnet-4-6 /anthropic/v1/messages tool_reference: the response completes and calls only offered tools', function () {
var content = Array.isArray(body.content) ? body.content : [];
var output = Array.isArray(body.output) ? body.output : [];
var calls = content.filter(function (b) { return b && b.type === 'tool_use'; }).map(function (b) { return b.name; })
.concat(output.filter(function (o) { return o && o.type === 'function_call'; }).map(function (o) { return o.name; }));
var bad = calls.filter(function (n) { return n !== 'find_tools' && n !== 'get_weather'; });
pm.expect(bad, 'tool call for a tool that was never offered: ' + txt.slice(0, 600)).to.eql([]);
